x2.description: array_like The second input array. Must be compatible with ``x1`` for all non-compute axes. The size of the axis over which to compute the cross-product must be the same size as the respective axis in ``x1``.

axis.description: int, optional The axis (dimension) of ``x1`` and ``x2`` containing the vectors for which to compute the cross-product. Default: ``-1``.

output.description: ------- ndarray An array containing the cross products.

constraints: x1 and x2 must have broadcast-compatible shapes
